{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}
module Demo where

open import Data.Nat using (ℕ; zero; suc; _+_)

{- outer {- nested -} still a comment -}
data Bool : Set where
  true  : Bool
  false : Bool

not : Bool → Bool
not true  = false
not false = true

double : ℕ → ℕ
double zero    = zero
double (suc n) = suc (suc (double n))

record Point : Set where
  field
    x y : ℕ

greeting = "Hello, Agda!"
two = 2
